name: Voxel Shader Volumetric Ray Marching
definition: A shading method for Fire/Smoke simulations and meshes that reads voxel grid data from a Phoenix Simulator or V-Ray Volume Grid. It handles volumetric shading via specific rollouts (Fire, Smoke Color, Smoke Opacity) because standard Maya materials cannot shade volumetrics.
summary: Voxel Shader Volumetric Ray Marching is a shading method that explicitly traces camera and shadow rays through voxel grids, distinguishing itself from neighbor-dependent pipelines by supporting configurable step sizes and procedural geometry modes.
